parsed.explanation: No current trans-specific criminalisation or documented border/facility ban is positive, and Pride/tourist hubs plus self-ID court floor improve climate, but visitor safety depends on consequences if outed. The record shows repeated transfemicides, impunity warnings, document-mismatch discrimination, and police corruption/nightlife raids targeting trans people; progressive laws are acknowledged as unevenly enforced. There is no organised visitor-targeting campaign or universal birth-sex rule, so above severe risk, but remedies are uncertain and enforcement varies sharply by state. Domestic recognition gaps are mostly resident-facing, though mismatch harms can reach travelers. Weighted to likely tourist centres with caution outside them, elevated-mid risk.
